findings.description: The `vi.mock('../core/session-lifecycle.service.js')` factory still has a `LowMemoryError` entry. It is typed against `errors/session-lifecycle.errors.js`, but `importOriginal` returns the service module, which no longer exports `LowMemoryError`, so the entry is `undefined` and nothing reads it. The same entry sits in `src/cli/index-2.test.ts` L140-142 and `src/cli/index-3.test.ts` L134-136. Delete it in all three files.

The `MalformedTaskSpecError` JSDoc says the SyntaxError message "is swallowed here", but after the move this file holds only the class. The code that drops the message is in `session.repository.ts`, so name that file or drop "here".
